entities.summary: Justin Karl Michael Broadrick is an English musician, singer and songwriter. He is best known as the lead singer, guitarist, and a founding member of the band Godflesh, one of the first bands to combine elements of extreme metal and industrial music. Following Godflesh's initial breakup in 2002, Broadrick formed the band Jesu.
